outcome: Clear cell carcinoma (CCC) of the abdominal wall
cohort: Six patients diagnosed with clear cell carcinoma of the abdominal wall at the National Taiwan University Hospital who had prior obstetric or gynecologic surgeries.
finding: Previous obstetric or gynecologic surgery can be a risk factor for clear cell carcinoma of the abdominal wall, and complete resection of the tumor with potential hysterectomy and lymph node dissection is suggested as primary treatment.
